items.message: Rename trunkFails to a predicate-prefixed boolean name such as shouldTrunkFail.
Rename gtCreateFails to a predicate-prefixed boolean name such as shouldGtCreateFail.
Rename branchResetFails to a predicate-prefixed boolean name such as shouldBranchResetFail.
Rename deleteBackupFails to a predicate-prefixed boolean name such as shouldDeleteBackupFail.
Rename restoreFails to a predicate-prefixed boolean name such as shouldRestoreFail.
Import the existing shortSha export instead of keeping a second copy in this file.
Remove the dead AvailableBranchName export or make the return type use it.
Rename usedSuffix to a predicate-prefixed name such as hasSuffix.
Rename usedSuffix to a predicate-prefixed name such as hasSuffix.
Change commitSummary to use ?? instead of ||.
Build commitSummary from the already-fetched SHA and subject instead of spawning git log --oneline.
Remove the dead AvailableBranchName export or switch chooseAvailableBranchName to use it.
Let the dirty-worktree flow proceed when upstream inspection fails; only hard-stop on head_not_in_upstream.
Use a more stable exit-code-based upstream check instead of relying on localized error strings.
